verdict.rationale: NVIDIA provides the official CUDA Toolkit SDK plus Nsight developer tools and NVIDIA AI Enterprise/NIM microservices for building GPU-accelerated and generative AI applications on H200 hardware, giving a genuine SDK surface to build against. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing/docs pages with no independent developer corroboration, and probes show broken docs-md and no discoverable OpenAPI spec, suggesting incomplete machine-readable API documentation for agentic/automated consumption. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of building against the SDK, agent-specific API/OpenAPI documentation, and confirmation the docs are structured for AI-native tooling.
